name: BIRD
description: BIRD is a large-scale benchmark for text-to-SQL tasks grounded in big databases, containing 12,751 text-to-SQL pairs and 95 databases across 37 professional domains. It emphasizes challenges from dirty database contents, external knowledge, and SQL efficiency in massive databases.
reputation: BIRD is a widely used and influential text-to-SQL benchmark for realistic, large-database querying, and it is commonly cited in academic and leaderboard evaluations.
notes: Highlights real-world challenges in text-to-SQL with large databases; includes leaderboard and source code.
